originality.rationale: The full primary studies are separated by implication: Hitchin already covers cubic rank deficiency and axis geometry, Zandieh-Han-Avron supplies general sampling methods, and Wang supplies the Legendre tail estimate. None of the inspected results or closest indexed mathematical records states or implies the simultaneous sharp five-axis uniform squared condition number 6 with equality degrees 2,4,8,14. A specialist unindexed prior theorem remains a priority risk.

value.rationale: The natural single-axis erasure from six icosahedral axes yields an exact, degree-uniform sharply conditioned five-value harmonic interpolation theorem, including all exceptional ranks and four isolated worst-case degrees; unlike finite one-off spectra, it supplies a reproducible all-degree stability constant. It does not confuse five-point data surjectivity with whole-harmonic reconstruction.
